description: Get Bitcoin profit metrics: LTH/STH Realized P/L (USD) and SOPR (Spent Output Profit Ratio). SOPR > 1 means coins moved at profit; < 1 means at loss. Requires Pro tier API key.

start_date.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Overrides days param when set.
